_meta_.description: Declarative specification for observing, reasoning, and generating academically grounded Field candidates from preserved Business Strategy Domains.
instruction: Treat this artifact as a generative specification rather than as generated Field state.
Preserve upstream BSD definitions and boundaries without modification.
Separate BSD-based observation from academic Field normalization.
Require traceable provenance for academically normalized Field identities and definitions.
Preserve BSD-level overlap, ambiguity, duplication, and ownership paradoxes rather than resolving them prematurely.
Keep generated state separate from this specification and materialize generation results into bsd2field_generated.json.
